summary: The Boiler Room is a SI-powered dashboard that analyzes the data from NASA's PSI database and educates its viewers about combustion in a fun and interactive way. Rather than forcing them to read lengthy, technical research papers, our Knight agent analyzes the data and explains it in everyday language to the reader, ensuring they can understand the key points of any investigation. Not only does it make complex data more clear to readers, it also provides a fun way to experiment in our Gravity Lab, Environment Comparison, and Mission Control tabs.
details:
Goal: To educate visitors on combustion by making complex and technical information more clear, engaging and welcoming.

Software used: Visual Studio Code, Python, OpenAI API, GitHub, Render

Factors considered: User-Friendly, Interactive UI, Easy-to-understand info, simple & complex simulations, application of knowledge
